stories.title: La santé intestinale des chiens et des chats est essentielle

en.title: Intestinal health of dogs and cats is essential
en.summary: Research indicates that gut microbiota balance supports digestion, immune function, and stress resilience in pets. Probiotic supplements may improve their overall wellness, as many animals experience gastrointestinal issues from stress, dietary changes, or antibiotics.

stories.title: QUIZ - Die neunziger Jahre feiern ein Revival: eine Zeitreise in 15 Fragen

en.title: QUIZ - The nineties are celebrating a revival: a journey through time in 15 questions
en.summary: A quiz tests knowledge about the 1990s, covering events including the Loveparade, German reunification, and the rise of the internet.

stories.title: Das Lied vom ewigen Opfer: Der Bruder von Lady Diana attackiert in seinem Buch «Swan Song» das Königshaus. Die Briten reagieren mit Verdruss

en.title: The song of eternal victimhood: Lady Diana's brother attacks the royal family in his book "Swan Song". The British respond with displeasure
en.summary: Charles Spencer's memoir about his sister Diana joins recent royal revelations and attracts critical attention as the British public grows weary of such disclosures about the royal family.

stories.title: GC trennt sich von Cheftrainer Peter Zeidler

en.title: GC separates from head coach Peter Zeidler
en.summary: The Zurich football club has ended its relationship with head coach Peter Zeidler. Assistant coaches Daniel Pavlovic and Shkelzen Gashi will take over interim management.

stories.title: Erst im Mai gekommen – GC trennt sich per sofort von Trainer Zeidler

en.title: Arriving only in May – GC parts ways with coach Zeidler immediately
en.summary: Grasshoppers have immediately separated from head coach Peter Zeidler, who joined the club in May. No successor has yet been named.

stories.title: Granit Xhaka admet s’être procuré un faux certificat Covid et ne participera pas au rassemblement de la Nati

en.title: Granit Xhaka admits obtaining a fake Covid certificate and will not participate in the Swiss national team gathering
en.summary: Swiss captain Granit Xhaka has admitted to forging a Covid vaccination certificate and will miss the national team gathering and four upcoming matches through October 6. He is under investigation by Lucerne's prosecutor's office.

stories.title: Granit Xhaka gibt zu, ein gefälschtes Covid-Zertifikat erworben zu haben – verliert der 33-Jährige jetzt die Captainbinde im Nationalteam?

en.title: Granit Xhaka admits acquiring a fake Covid certificate – will the 33-year-old now lose the captain's armband in the national team?
en.summary: The 33-year-old Granit Xhaka confirms obtaining a forged Covid certificate and refusing vaccination. He will miss upcoming international matches, though his future as national team captain remains uncertain.

stories.title: Football - Granit Xhaka manque le rassemblement de la Nati après l'aveu d'un faux certificat Covid

en.title: Football - Granit Xhaka misses Swiss national team gathering after admitting to fake Covid certificate
en.summary: Switzerland will play its next four Nations League matches without captain Granit Xhaka, who admitted on Monday to using a forged Covid certificate.

stories.title: Les Etats-Unis ont discuté avec la Chine d'un «mécanisme» de dialogue sur l'IA

en.title: The United States discussed with China a "mechanism" for dialogue on artificial intelligence
en.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent proposed to China a notification mechanism between the two countries regarding artificial intelligence incidents affecting national security and advocated for transparency in AI development.

stories.title: La Chine et les Etats-unis ont discuté d'un mécanisme de dialogue sur l'IA

en.title: China and the United States discussed a dialogue mechanism on AI
en.summary: The United States proposed to China the creation of a dialogue mechanism between the two powers regarding artificial intelligence, amid concerns about the technology potentially becoming uncontrolled.

stories.title: Purge politique, débat déserté par les candidats et vote en public: en Russie, le triomphe garanti du parti de Vladimir Poutine

en.title: Political purge, debate deserted by candidates and public voting: in Russia, the guaranteed triumph of Vladimir Putin's party
en.summary: Russia's United Russia party won legislative elections held on Sunday, expected to exceed its 2021 results, following a campaign widely mocked on social media in a contest considered to provide legitimacy only to the Kremlin.

stories.title: Le parti de Vladimir Poutine donné vainqueur des premières élections depuis la guerre en Ukraine

en.title: Vladimir Putin's party projected to win first elections since Ukraine war
en.summary: Putin's United Russia party is expected to win Sunday's legislative elections. The voting took place amid Ukrainian drone attacks and cyberattacks.

stories.title: Kühlen verboten: Wie die Baubürokratie Hauseigentümer weiter schwitzen lässt

en.title: Cooling forbidden: How building bureaucracy leaves homeowners sweating
en.summary: Approval processes for air conditioning systems remain restrictive, and units are often sold out during summer. Homeowners planning to cool their homes next summer should begin preparations now.

stories.title: Wie Donald Trump die Medikamentenpreise beim BAG mitbestimmt

en.title: How Donald Trump influences drug prices at the Swiss health authority
en.summary: Trump's efforts to reduce high medication prices in the US by capping what Americans pay relative to other countries could affect Switzerland, potentially making new therapies more expensive or available later.

stories.title: Brasiliens Wirtschaft wächst. Doch für viele Unternehmer ist eine vierte Amtszeit Lulas das Horrorszenario

en.title: Brazil's economy grows. But for many entrepreneurs, a fourth term for Lula is a nightmare scenario
en.summary: Brazil's economy is expanding, though business leaders express concerns about a potential fourth term for President Lula. Flávio Bolsonaro's economic program has not yet persuaded the business elite, despite their interest in a change of power in Brasília.

stories.title: «Nackt kündigen» – junge Chinesen entfliehen dem Druck im Job

en.title: "Naked resignation" – young Chinese escape job pressure
en.summary: Young Chinese workers are increasingly rejecting the intense career pressures of their society, stepping away from professional advancement. This trend reflects a broader erosion of China's traditional promise of upward mobility among younger generations.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Putin läuft die Lebenszeit davon», sagt der frühere BND-Chef. Er rechnet daher mit einer baldigen Eskalation

en.title: INTERVIEW - "Putin is running out of time," says former BND chief. He therefore expects an imminent escalation
en.summary: A former German foreign intelligence service director believes Putin faces time constraints and predicts near-term escalation. He argues that German intelligence should be permitted to sabotage foreign weapons manufacturing facilities.
